description: Shortlist electricity, gas or dual offers using the website monthly bill estimates and sorting, unknowns last. Supply annual_kwh and/or annual_smc; defaults are 2700 kWh and 1400 Smc. Filter providers and price_types. No province/address filter or availability check; returned assumptions describe the illustrative household/location. Conditional prices retain qualifications. Reuse consumption in get_product/compare_products energy context.

annual_kwh.description: Annual electricity consumption. Website default: 2700 kWh.

annual_smc.description: Annual gas consumption. Website default: 1400 Smc.

locale.description: Website link language; source terms may remain Italian.

providers.description: Exact provider IDs from results; unknown IDs are rejected.

name: search_energy
